capabilities: Scroll the editor while typing when the cursor reaches a trigger point
Keep the cursor inside a viewport band during keyboard and Vim-motion navigation
Scroll on fixed steps when pressing the Up or Down arrow keys
Scroll when the mouse pointer nears the top or bottom edge of the viewport
Configure trigger point, step size, cooldown, smooth scrolling, and near-bottom limits
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: In Obsidian, the cursor can reach the bottom of the viewport while writing or navigating, forcing manual scrolling to keep the working line visible.
summary: Auto-scroll plugin that keeps the editor scrolling while typing, navigating, or moving the mouse, with support for Vim motions and fixed arrow-key steps.
